about_the_game:
Strategy Game | Roguelike | Chinese Aesthetic Storytelling

[Chu Jiang RU Xiang] is a strategy roguelike game inspired by the artistry of traditional Chinese Peking Opera!

Every battle is a life-and-death duel on the operatic stage, and every lyric is a blade cloaked in poetic grace. Step into the roles of legendary Peking Opera characters, wielding song as your blade and performance as your shield as you battle fiercely through the enchanted Pear Garden.

🎭 Core Features

▌Classic Plays, Reinterpreted

Shuttle through classic plays such as The White Snake, Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, and The Case of Chen Shimei, and embark on a special experience of "Cross-Historical Showdowns".

▌Words as Weapons

"Lyrics become deadly Skill": Draw power from poetic verses and transform melodies into combat skills.

▌Sheng, Dan, Jing, Chou—A Symphony of Roles

Build unique strategies with diverse character decks, each representing classic opera archetypes. Victory hinges on your tactical choices!

▌Enter, Exit, and the Stage's Eternal Cycle

Blending Roguelike progression, character interactions, and skill combinations offers a gaming experience with diverse gameplay combinations!

【Developer’s Note】

Crafted by a passionate small team, designed to deliver fast-paced, exhilarating gameplay.

We’re refining the experience iteratively—try our demo and share your insights!

The full version will feature a broader roster of characters, new gameplay modes, and exciting under-development surprises.

The curtain rises—step into the opera!

Add to your wishlist now and prepare to duel on the stage of fate!

From the dev team: This game is our tribute to the artistry of Chinese opera. We hope you love it.
